value.rationale: The source explicitly lists rigorous global convergence as open and offers only restricted boundedness and finite numerics. The exact invasion boundary is independent of fear, yet an exact universal 1/t rate for both species depends strictly and oppositely on fear; this resolves an ecologically motivated threshold-transient ambiguity rather than an arbitrary slice. The all-rate/no-cycle theorem supports applicability of the critical constants to all positive initial densities.
